note: Phase 5 Design is NEW under Shape A (2026-04-24). Owner: @ux-designer. Reads PRD (Phase 4) + personas (Phase 2) + tech-stack + a11y baseline (Phase 3); produces UX spec + brand-guidelines + prototype; exits via PRD reconciliation pass that converts design-deltas into PRD v(N+1) lightweight amendments. `flag_for_architecture_ADR` deltas carry forward as MANDATORY ADR requirements at Phase 6 entry — silent-divergence guard. (The dedicated `narrative` wrapper skill was retired WS5-B §8 item 6 — narrative/brand-voice work is now ad-hoc `skills/creative/storytelling` usage, not a gated Phase 5 deliverable. `legacy-ui-assessment` moved to reference/brownfield-pending/ pending the brownfield capability pack, §7.6 — see ledger delta D17; brownfield UI legacy-assessment is not currently gated at Phase 5.)
entry_conditions: `coldpress.yaml baselines:` block present with a11y axis declared

acceptance_checks.description: PRD `_context/sacred/prd.md` is locked (re-verified at Phase 5 exit; staleness check: prd.last_modified <= phase-4-to-5 handoff written_at, or PRD v(N+1) emitted by reconciliation pass)
acceptance_checks.remediation: If PRD was edited mid-Phase-5 outside the reconciliation pass, route through `phase-transition` reconciliation. If PRD-stale was caused by upstream edit, re-run Phase 5 from `design-brief` Step 0 with refreshed graph.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/design/brand-guidelines-v{latest}.md` exists, validates against `schemas/design/brand-guidelines.schema.json`, sidecar `.meta.json` exists, tokens auto-validated against active a11y baseline contrast minimums
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@ux-designer brand-guidelines` after `design-brief` completes. Token-contrast failures resolve via revising tokens or downgrading a11y opt-in via Phase 3 baselines re-entry.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/design/prototype/{date}/manifest.json` exists, validates against `schemas/design/prototype-manifest.schema.json`. Manifest declares `mode` (code-skeleton | mock-spec | clickable-html) matching archetype (override-with-rationale path allowed)
Phase 5 handoff log `phase-5-to-6-{date}.md` has a `design_deltas:` section (can be empty list `[]`). Every delta validates against `schemas/handoffs/design-delta.schema.json`
acceptance_checks.remediation: Each Phase 5 skill emits design-deltas during finalisation; phase-transition aggregates. If section is missing, re-run phase-transition aggregation step.

acceptance_checks.description: Every `design_delta` in handoff log has `user_decision` set (one of: accept_into_prd, reject, flag_for_architecture_ADR, park_for_phase_11). For accept_into_prd deltas, PRD v(N+1) exists with bumped VC and `prd.meta.json.amendment_source: phase-5-reconciliation`
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `phase-transition` reconciliation pass. @pm prompts user per delta; accepted deltas trigger lightweight PRD amendment via `validate-prd --sections=<accepted_target_sections>`.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/handoffs/phase-5-to-6-{date}.md` exists, valid against extended `phase-handoff.schema.json` (includes `design_deltas: [DesignDelta]` and optional `architecture_adrs_required: [...]` arrays)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Invoke `phase-transition` at Phase 5 exit. Phase 6 entry skill MUST consume `architecture_adrs_required:` if non-empty (silent-divergence guard).

acceptance_checks.description: a11y-audit (Phase 5 design-time invocation) completed; zero Critical violations open. Archetype-conditional severity: design-led/WDS=block; standard=warn; vibe-coder-lean=skip-unless-explicit. Reads `coldpress.yaml baselines.a11y` for conformance level (A/AA/AAA; default AA).
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@qa a11y-audit` (Phase 5 mode). Brand-token contrast failures forward-carry as design-deltas → reconcile via `phase-transition` step-02a back to `brand-guidelines` for re-tokenisation.
